description:
The corrected half of the fault case study: byte-for-byte the same manifest as synthetic_fault.yaml with the injected defect removed from the candidate. Every acceptance criterion and every tolerance is unchanged, which is what makes the pair a fair before/after: the only thing that moved is the subject under test.
This is also the negative control for the whole validator. If it does not PASS, the tolerances are too tight and every failure this tool reports is suspect.
